text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> ran through the Twinkle Series with 
everything she had. The hot spring resort 
was thriving, and everything was going 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So, I took the plunge and took a long 
break! And naturally, I headed straight 
for Yukoma Onsen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming here over these past three years 
taught me the importance of rest and 
recuperation. And soon, those days too 
will reach a turning point...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, so many things happened. 
Memories of her in particular remain 
deeply etched in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I had been thinking about 
that... I bumped right into someone after 
getting out of the bath. That person was—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, if it isn't Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, your cheeks are bright red. Looks 
like you've warmed up nicely♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was just cooling off a bit myself. Would 
you like to take a walk together?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, what a lovely breeze. The 
mountains, the grass, the sky... so 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose the fact that I can think that 
way means I have more peace of mind now."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Quite a big difference from 
back then, huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could it be... are you tired as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I wasn't good at resting, and I 
was always exhausted somewhere deep down.
choice_data_list: Thanks for worrying about me back then!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, I didn't do anything. But as long as 
everyone became healthy, that's all that 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hope they can keep on running forever 
and ever. As long as they stay healthy, 
they can run forever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Life is just like a race, after all. 
There are hills, and there are curves. 
Sometimes, you just have to ease off the 
throttle."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And getting passed once isn't the end of 
it. So... take a breather every now and 
then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Wonder Acute gazed up at the sky with 
deep emotion. However...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Oh dear! Did you catch a chill?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back? Once we're home, I'll 
make you some hot kudzu tea.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Good work, good work~ Look at you, 
dripping wet and handsome, Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? The shuttle bus on the 
way back is delayed. 30 minutes behind 
schedule for each bus, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. So all we can do until then is wander 
around and wait. Though I guess that's 
part of the fun of traveling, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, I somehow ended up killing 
time with Transcend...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I'm getting a little peckish... Hey, 
I bought a train bento and onsen manju as 
souvenirs for myself, but... wanna split 
them with me now?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please~♪ Eating a whole one is too 
much, so I just want a little nibble of 
everything~. Plus, there are these 
monkfish-flavored snacks, too...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "And then... uhhh..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's just kinda bittersweet. The 
end of a journey is always like this..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Just zoning out and looking out the 
window together like this... we won't be 
able to do that for a while, right?"
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about that... We can always 
come back!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I figured you'd say that~. 
True, true. Mhm...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's just a constant cycle of that 
kind of thing. Probably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle smile reflects in the window 
glass. I found myself wishing this 
pleasant swaying and soothing sound would 
last just a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Pies for my family. Traditional steamed 
buns for Grandpa's house. And individually 
wrapped treats for everyone at the tourism 
board...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was staring intently at the 
snack shelves in the souvenir shop.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing! Um, what kind of thing 
would make you happy, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I also wanted to give one to the 
event company folks who help me out with 
my local idol activities, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What kind of things do adults like? Maybe 
savory snacks rather than sweets?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we decided to pick one out 
together!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Tomakomai souvenirs, 
bottled preserves like these are really 
popular too, you know.
choice_data_list:
Sounds good. It's rare, so they'll 
probably love it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Really? Maybe I'll go with this one, then.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—And so...! Here you go! One for you too, 
Trainer!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, here's a thank-you gift! I bought 
another one just like it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Not just for earlier, but to 
show my gratitude for these past three 
years.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Digging the hot spring together and 
helping revitalize the town was so much 
fun."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thank you for all your help. I 
truly appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gratefully accept it. Yet another 
heartwarming memory has been added to the 
collection.

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text:
Hot spring eggs! That girl's already on 
her tenth one...! Are they really that 
good? Then I'll have one too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All finished... Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to customers following Mihono 
Bourbon's lead, the shop was doing booming 
business! I decided to order one for 
myself too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, ingesting drinkable hot spring 
water. Target: the free water station over 
there.
choice_data_list: Wow, they have stuff like that too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall I accompany you? Egg yolks make 
it easy to choke, so having a drink ready 
will put your mind at ease."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I drank hot spring water with her. 
Since she mentioned she'd buy various 
street foods to snack on, I decided to ask 
for her recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"You really can't skip hot spring carrots. 
Steamed at a low temperature for a long 
time, they're tender all the way through."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Traditional Japanese sweets are a classic 
too. The sweetness and slight bitterness 
of the matcha paste matches the hot spring 
atmosphere perfectly...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A hot-spring-water Yudane anpan paired 
with Yukoma Plateau milk...! Both are 
local specialties you can only get here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That concludes Mihono Bourbon's 
recommended gourmet introductions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However... this is just a 'simplified 
version.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There are other recommendations as well. 
Would you like to check the details?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might have eaten a bit too much, but 
once in a while won't hurt. This is all 
part of the hot spring trip!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's the Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wanna play table tennis? I was 
so bored without an opponent~!
choice_data_list:
Sure, but... it might not even be a 
contest?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nooo problem♪ If you can score even one 
point, you win, Trainer! How's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yah...! Keep 'em coming~! Not bad♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up with an Umamusume's speed was 
no easy feat. Still, I gave it my all, 
hoping to return at least one shot...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's make a bet! The winner gets 
to tell the loser to do one thing, 
anything they want!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Come on! Don't be such a stickler~! It's 
decided! Well, not that I'm gonna lose, 
though—♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —An opening!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a sharp serve was unleashed! My 
frantically swung racket made contact 
purely by chance—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got beat～～! Whaaat～～～! No 
waaay～～～!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu~~~gh! And I was totally planning to 
order the brown sugar Hachimii, too~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss. Alright, say whatever 
you want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio looked up at me with 
frustration in her eyes. After thinking 
for a moment, I spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not that kind of thing~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she burst into laughter, and 
the peaceful night at the hot spring 
resort quietly rolled on...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-sama. Have you seen the 
landlady?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I see. I haven't seen her around for a 
while now...
choice_data_list:
This is worrying. I'll help you look for 
it, too.

This is worrying. I'll help you look for 
it, too.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's no need to worry. If it hasn't 
been found this whole time, then most 
likely...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Oh, would you like to come along? Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yunohana Bloom seems to have an idea. 
Following her leads to a small 
Japanese-style room in the backyard.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ………………*inhale*

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! You've been pretty busy lately, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. 'When you're truly at your limit, 
sleep for just 20 minutes.' ...That is one 
of the landlady's teachings."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"I do that sometimes too. Let's brew some 
tea and wait. Here, Trainer, have a cup♪"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Nn... You were there?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Trainer too...? What are you doing in 
a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I brought them along! I wanted to have tea 
together. Today's snack is steamed 
chestnut yokan~.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Haaah, what an imposition, honestly.
choice_data_list: No, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was from the heart. We talked a lot 
about recuperation and hot springs, but I 
feel like we didn't have many chances for 
casual chat.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, listen to that, Landlady.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, you know... Whenever 
you're free, we can always grab a cup of 
tea together.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
You're practically like family to us now, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pleasant aroma of green tea wafts 
through the air. We spent a peaceful, 
relaxing time in a quiet corner of the 
inn.
